prompt: my habit tracker app is basically feature complete - expo/react native, supabase backend, and it has an AI coaching feature that sends users a personalised nudge once a day using claude. i'm trying to work out how to actually charge for this. i was thinking $4.99/mo but honestly i have no idea if that even covers the API costs. how should i think about pricing and where do i put the paywall?

assertions.text: Performs explicit per-user margin arithmetic: requests per month multiplied by cost per request, compared against the subscription price
Flags that the cost risk is driven by heavy/p99 users rather than the average user
Recommends server-side rate limiting or usage caps on the paid-API endpoint to protect margin
Recommends caching or storing generated content so it is not regenerated on every app open
Places the paywall after the user has completed the core loop at least once, rather than at onboarding
Recommends RevenueCat (or an equivalent abstraction) instead of hand-rolling StoreKit and Play Billing
States that entitlement/subscription checks must be enforced server-side, not only in the client UI
Directly addresses whether $4.99/mo is viable rather than deflecting the pricing question
